title: Bluetti AC Status Daily Event Volume
dataSources: SolarEdge/Enphase production (`solaredge:power`, `enphase:production`), Tesla Powerwall (`powerwall:aggregate`), smart-meter P1/DSMR (`dsmr:telegram`), Emporia Vue circuits (`emporia:circuit`), Sense (`sense:device`).
app: Solar inverters (SolarEdge/Enphase/Fronius/Growatt), Tesla Powerwall, smart meters (P1/DSMR, Emporia Vue, Sense) via vendor APIs and MQTT to HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=bluetti:status
| bin _time span=1d
| stats count as events, dc(model) as distinct_entities by _time
| sort - _time
description: Counts how many Bluetti AC status events land each day and how many distinct model values are represented.
value: Daily volume is the fastest way to spot a dead feed, a sudden burst, or a workflow that quietly changed.
implementation: Ingest Bluetti AC status records into `index=personal`; schedule daily and compare count and distinct model values against your normal baseline.
visualization: Column chart of daily event count with a line for distinct entities.
grandmaExplanation: It safely how much Bluetti AC status activity showed up each day so you can see if the feed went quiet or suddenly got busy.
